events.title: American Pinball Warrior
events.description:
The club will be open Friday, June 19th from 7:00 - 11:00 pm and running an American Pinball Warrior event during this time. 

The event consists of 5 machines with an objective on each. Your goals is to complete the objective on each machine as fast as possible to get the lowest time. If you miss an objective you do not get a time. The lowest time at the end of the night gets to pick from our box of prizes (trans-lights, mugs, shirts...) 

Everyone gets 2 free attempts with admission. Extra attempts are $2 each or 3/$5.

events.title: Learn to Play Crokinole
events.description:
Curious about Crokinole? Always wanted to check out the Southern New Hampshire Pinball Club?
Now's your chance to do both!
Join us for a fun, casual evening where you can learn one of the world's most addictive tabletop games while enjoying an incredible collection of pinball machines. Whether you've never played Crokinole or you're looking to sharpen your game before league season, everyone is welcome.
✅ FREE Event
✅ No experience necessary
✅ Learn to play Crokinole
✅ Play pinball throughout the evening
✅ Meet local players and make new friends

We'll have experienced players teaching the basics, plenty of boards available, and lots of opportunities to jump right into games. In just a few minutes you'll be sinking 20s and wondering why you didn't discover Crokinole sooner.
Bring a friend, bring your family, or just bring your curiosity—we'll provide everything you need to play.
See you on July 6!
Flick. Flip. Have Fun.
Learn more:

New England Crokinole League: necrokinole.com
Southern New Hampshire Pinball Club: https://www.snhpinballclub.com
